The U-Word: Why Software Developers Should Talk About Unions - Mathieu Ropert - ACCU 2025 Short Talks
---

In this ACCU 2025 lightning talk, Mathieu Ropert dives into a topic rarely discussed in software engineering: unions. Titled The U-Word, this fast-paced and thought-provoking session explores why software developers should be talking about unionization in tech - and why they often don’t.

Drawing from his experience as a union representative and seasoned engineer, Mathieu reflects on workplace advocacy for engineers, the silence around organizing software engineers, and the cultural differences between union-friendly countries like Sweden and more hesitant tech environments. The talk confronts developer workplace issues such as unmanaged technical debt, developer burnout, and a lack of engineering voice in decision-making.
